trans-unit.source: So, what the heck did you do to get yourself arrested and then thrown in a dungeon?
trans-unit.target: So, what the heck did you do to get yourself arrested and then thrown in a dungeon?

trans-unit.source: I went to bed at Uncle Olson's house. Then, at midnight...
trans-unit.target: I went to bed at Uncle Olson's house. Then, at midnight...

trans-unit.source: Dude... That sucks. Your uncle totally sold you out.

trans-unit.source: Well, life's full of surprises, for better or worse. Don't lose too much sleep over it.
